name: Wutong Holding Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Wutong Holding Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells intelligent telecommunication devices in China and internationally. The company offers radio frequency connection products, including RF connectors, cables and components, test measuring and accessories, millimeter waves, and attachments, as well as communication antennas; optical interconnection products, such as high-density optical fiber transmission, pre-connected products, PLC fiber optic splitters, optical cables, and photoelectric composites; new energy connection products comprising energy storage connectors, photovoltaic cable assemblies, integrated bus CCS, and hard and soft copper bars; and MBB …
